facts.description:

Because of this, you might see a warning saying my account may not be real when you try to follow me.

Don't be scared to follow me. I'm a real person, and my content is worth it 🤍

Listen for the signs that you’re meant to be seen, even if they don’t always make sense.
ㅤ
Save this or send it to someone who needs to hear it 😉🙏
ㅤ
#manifestation #spiritualawakening #quantumshifting #spirituality #manifesting #theuniverse #abundancemindset

transcript.text: These are weird signs that you are meant to be famous.
Number one, you are an extroverted introvert,
meaning there is a part of you
that is extremely private and uncomfortable being seen.
And another part of you that is extremely outgoing
and loud spoken and loves other people.
You see, the introverted part of you
is the part of you that is processing
your unique frequency, your unique genius.
And the extroverted part of you
is basically what the universe gave you
so that you can be able to spread
that unique frequency and genius.
Number two, you have always known
ever since you were really little
that you were destined for something greater
or destined for something more,
and you had no idea what that even meant.
But you just knew deep down in your soul
that you were not like the people around you.
Number three, you having natural talent
of making other people feel seen when they are around you.
Why is this the case?
Because our reality is just a mirrored projection of ourselves.
So if you have the gift
of truly being able to see others,
that means that others can truly see you.
